j.basis: English name J and visual inspection of the letter-shaped sprite

item-pedestal.basis: Translation of the website name Item Pedestal

rarecrow.basis: Planner rarecrow sprite depicts rarecrow style 8; replace the ambiguous machine translation.

apple-tree-summer.basis: The source ID, English name and atlas frame identify the apple summer sprite; upstream seasonSprite incorrectly names pomegranate-tree/winter.

banana-tree-winter.message_zh: 本地香蕉树冬季贴图呈小型芽状图形，与其他季节的成熟树外观差异较大。原因未查明，请确认目标外观。
banana-tree-winter.message_en: The bundled winter banana sprite depicts a small shoot. Its intended appearance is unverified; ask the user to confirm.

crop_placeholders.basis: User-requested visual simplification; ordinary crop and seed tiles use strawberries, giant crops use pumpkins while retaining footprint dimensions.

mature_trees.note_zh: 成熟树木按树干1×1格规划；树冠可以与其他元素重叠，可种在建筑物（包括温室）旁的可用格子。果树生长期需要周围八格空置，成熟布局不预留3×3生长空间；忽略雷击外观。
mature_trees.basis: User-requested mature-tree layout convention; canopy and growth clearance do not define the occupied trunk tile.

slime_hutch.note_zh: 史莱姆小屋在1.6版本由11×6缩小至7×4，规划统一使用7×4。参考图若为11×6，在交付时说明差异，由用户选择如何处理剩余空间。

rendering_source.basis: GreenhouseEntrance_top/bottom draw layers; corresponding tiles are hidden when a path is present.

front_decoration.note_zh: 温室前方3×2为自带砖块效果，不计作独立地板或占地；可被地板覆盖，也可放置小桶等物体。

building_placement.semantics: The layout reserves only 7 x 6. The front 3 x 2 brick decoration does not reserve clearance and may be covered or occupied. Original construction data remains in source-index.json.

greenhouse.note_zh: 规划只使用温室7×6占地；前方3×2自带砖块可被铺装覆盖或摆放物品，不作为额外留空区，不识别为独立地板。
greenhouse.basis: User-requested 7 x 6 layout convention; native entrance art and path replacement verified in stardewplan rendering code.

fish-pond.card_label_zh: 水色、网兜朝向可变；规划用默认外观
fish-pond.card_label_en: Water / net layout may vary; use default
fish-pond.note_zh: 鱼塘可切换网兜等装饰细节的方向或样式，饲养不同鱼类时池水颜色也可能不同。统一识别为鱼塘，规划使用5×5的默认外观；忽略这些差异，无需创建其他变体或待确认问题。
fish-pond.note_en: Fish ponds can vary in net and decoration orientation and in water color depending on the fish. Recognize them as the same fish pond and use the default 5 x 5 appearance without variant-specific review issues.

mushroom-log.note_zh: 蘑菇树桩底部有明显的绿色覆盖物，与圆木段容易混淆。蘑菇树桩还可呈长出蘑菇的待收获外观，两种状态占位均为1×1。

log-section.note_zh: 圆木段为木制装饰物，外观有浅色圆形截面；请与底部带绿色覆盖物的蘑菇树桩比较，勿互相替代。

greenhouse-repaired.note_zh: 温室按7×6规划。完整外观前方凸出的3×2砖块为建筑自带效果，不单独放置、识别为地板或计数；玩家地板可覆盖该处，小桶和其他物品也可放置。图例中的铺装覆盖样式是独立地板，复刻时按可见铺装保留。
greenhouse-repaired.card_note_zh: 前方3×2可铺地板、放小桶等物品；自带砖块不计作地板。
greenhouse-repaired.card_note_en: Front 3x2: flooring or objects allowed. Built-in bricks are not floor items.
